mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate, compressing the equity risk premium and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is greater than -0.03 or p-value > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE) indicates labor market slack, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in manufacturing production (INDPRO) signals weakening corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline does not yield negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 850,000 units (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the residential sector, reducing consumer wealth and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 850.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 230.0) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a 'stagflation' risk, which triggers equity market sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 230.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns, but only during late-cycle economic expansions when the unemployment rate is below 4.0%.
failure_condition: RSAFS decline does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.
